transcript_rule: Show the full conversation for context, but color-mark only the student whose individual report is being viewed.
corrected_conversation_rule: Show the full natural-English conversation, but color-mark only the corrected segments belonging to the student whose report is being viewed.
privacy_and_reporting_rule: Do not include teacher-to-assistant comments, internal analysis notes, implementation notes, or user feedback about report generation.
pronunciation_rule: Pronunciation issues are marked inside the transcript/corrected material under the Pronunciation & Intelligibility color, not in a separate meta-comment box.
